scope: Read-only audit of remaining Activity follow/read and first-unread focus integration; no product changes.

source.official: Locked v1.21.22 ThreadsInbox-CbSKTW4g.js.pretty.txt first-unread effect around856; original TSX ThreadsInbox.tsx 997–1061 and LeftRail.tsx focusFirstUnreadActivity.

findings: thread.followers already returns authoritative following state; activity.list/DiscoveryRow do not carry it. Avoid wording that the whole backend lacks follow state.
Existing ThreadActivityClient verifies an unknown follow result via read, does not blindly resend.
Kernel thread_access eligibility removes ordinary explicitly unfollowed threads; new unread exact mentions override exclusion. This is proven behavior, not a UI defect to silently remove.

Official first-unread gesture holds presentation intent until loaded visible items contain unread, scrolls/highlights without opening detail or marking read, clears highlight after3s. Loom has scroll restoration but not this focus intent.

No new backend endpoint or independent frontend business state is needed merely to read follow state. Exact upstream retention semantics would require a separately scoped contract compatibility decision.

checks.kernel: node --test --test-name-pattern="explicit unfollow|Activity copies|explicit mark unread" packages/kernel/test/global-discovery.test.ts:3 passed

remaining: Pure frontend first-unread focus gesture remains unimplemented.
Activity menu follow/read controls need lazy authoritative state and explicit retention semantics; not accepted by this audit.
No new all-page visual acceptance, real CLI or paid calls.
deployment: Unchanged; no repair or runtime change requiring restart.
